NASA URLs use chosen day and bbox; dateline selections produce two valid views
Country order and displayed values equal the shipped atlas
Four-step judge tour reaches the actual evidence, card and validation
Hourly, baseline, shift, calendar and map state survive direct links
GIS download is decompressed GeoJSON identical to the selected source
Policy brief numbers derive from the receipt; print is one page
Citation is downloadable and DOI publication remains explicitly pending
Punjab claim PNG is readable at phone width and keeps all context
API paths exist and iframe badge carries context without site navigation

External NASA URL parsing verified separately; these checks verify constructed URLs.
